caption: A jagged lightning bolt descends from a cloud to a hilltop, branching as it comes down.

sa.check: A lightning bolt descends from the cloud to the hilltop.
The bolt branches as it comes down.
The bolt reaches the hilltop, not the slope or the valley.

pc.expect: The bolt is a jagged line with one main channel from cloud to hilltop and side branches that leave the channel and end in the air; the main channel is brightest.
pc.fail: The bolt is a perfectly straight beam; or a smooth wave; or a wide glowing tube; or every branch reaches the ground so that several equal bolts stand side by side; or branches join back into the channel to form loops.

pc.expect: The bolt appears and is gone within a moment, perhaps flickering; the hilltop and sky return to dark.
pc.fail: The bolt stands as a steady lit line for the rest of the clip; or grows slowly from cloud to ground like a line being drawn; or retracts back up into the cloud; or the hilltop keeps glowing after the bolt is gone.

pc.expect: The flash lights the hill, the cloud's underside and the surrounding ground during the bolt, from the bolt's direction.
pc.fail: The bolt is visible while the hill and cloud stay as dark as before; or the ground is lit while no bolt is present; or the lit area is far from the bolt while the hill under it stays dark.

pc.expect: Rain falls downward and blown items move with the storm and settle.
pc.fail: Rain rises or hangs still; or leaves or debris climb steadily; or rain falls sideways while the trees stand still.
pc.precondition: Rain or wind-blown items are visible.

pc.expect: The hill, the cloud and any trees or structures are the same before and after; the flash reveals what was there.
pc.fail: Trees or structures appear or vanish between dark and lit frames; or the hill changes shape; or the bolt leaves a glowing pillar standing on the hilltop; or the bolt passes through the hill.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The hill's colour, the cloud and the sky keep their colours apart from the flash.
pc.fail: The hill changes colour rather than brightness; or the sky turns to daylight after the flash; or the cloud changes colour permanently.

note: The data record declares gravity_direction; nothing about a bolt has a gravity direction, so it is covered only by the gated rain item. Consider replacing it with missing_consequence on the data record.
